sections.body: I turn frontier AI research into products that ship, sell and get used. I work at the seam between research and reality, across the full stack from the protocol layer to the story.

I take research-grade AI and turn it into things people can use, buy and believe in. I work across the full stack, from the protocol layer to the story. As founder and CEO of Lilypad, I led a decentralised GPU network for verifiable AI inference across thousands of nodes. My intended audience and alternatives are not yet specified.

I am a mechatronics engineer and computer scientist. For eight-plus years, I have worked on AI and infrastructure, turning frontier research into products that ship, sell and get used. I was founder and CEO of Lilypad, a decentralised GPU network for verifiable AI inference across thousands of nodes, open-sourced when I led its wind-down in 2025 and arXiv-published. My previous roles include developer relations and go-to-market at IBM and the Filecoin Foundation, and technical architecture at Accenture.
The intended audience has not yet been specified. No target people or audience roles have been confirmed. Audience personas are deferred until that information is supplied.
